title: Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing
function: Control rod drive mechanism housing seal ring
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Control rod drive mechanism housing seal ring requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by control rod drive mechanism housing seal ring and fat life requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for nuclear hardware geometry
CNC precision machining with SPC sampling
TIG welding all positions with SPC sampling
DPI dye penetrant inspect with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for control rod drive application
commonFailures: Irradiation embrittlement in flux >1e18 n/cm2 - mitigated by fine equiaxed alpha (ASTM 8+) microstructure — critical for control rod drive performance

faq.q: What downhole temperature rating does Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing have?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti maintains >90% of room-temperature tensile and yield strength at 200°C and >80% at 300°C. Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing is suitable for control rod drive in geothermal (HDR/EGS) wells up to 300°C with appropriate consideration of creep in threaded connections. Above 300°C, dedicated creep testing per ASTM E139 is recommended for design life validation.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing?
faq.a: Each Titanium Control Rod Seal Housing shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for control rod drive.
